# Code pipeline runs

14 calls. Every request needs the `Authorization` header: see [the overview](../index.md).

## `pipelineRuns.list`

```http
GET /code-pipelines/processes
```

Every pipeline run of the tenant (unbounded; prefer `runs.list({ types: ["CodePipeline"] })`).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=GET%20%2Fcode-pipelines%2Fprocesses).

**Response:** [`CodePipelineProcess`](../types/code-pipeline-process.md)`[]` (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X GET "https://api.maitento.com/code-pipelines/processes" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH"
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const runs = await mt.pipelineRuns.list();
```
```python title="Python"
mt.pipeline_runs.list()
```
<!-- /tabs -->

## `pipelineRuns.answer`

```http
POST /code-pipelines/processes/by-id/{id}/answer
```

Answers the question a run is waiting on.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fcode-pipelines%2Fprocesses%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fanswer).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`CodePipelineProcessAnswerRequest`](../types/code-pipeline-process-answer-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | `uuid` | yes | The question's `id`, from the step's `humanInteractionRequests`. |
| `answer` | `string` | yes | The answer: one of the suggested answers, or your own. |

**Response:** no body (204)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/code-pipelines/processes/by-id/<id>/answer" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"requestId":"...","answer":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.pipelineRuns.answer("aa11bb22-cc33-4d44-8e55-ff6677889900", { requestId: "3e4f5a6b-7c8d-4e9f-a0b1-c2d3e4f5a6b7", answer: "Use the v2 API." });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.pipeline_runs.answer("b7e6d5c4-3a2b-4c1d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", "d2e3f4a5-b6c7-4d8e-9f0a-1b2c3d4e5f6a", "Use PostgreSQL.")
```

## `pipelineRuns.payloads`

```http
POST /code-pipelines/processes/by-id/{id}/payloads/by-ids
```

Full tool-use and context-entry payloads by id (an unknown run answers empty lists).

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=POST%20%2Fcode-pipelines%2Fprocesses%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fpayloads%2Fby-ids).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`CodePipelineProcessPayloadsByIdsRequest`](../types/code-pipeline-process-payloads-by-ids-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toolUseIds` | `uuid[]` |  | The ids of the tool calls to fetch. At most 500; ask for more in further requests. Send an empty array for none. |
| `contextEntryIds` | `uuid[]` |  | The ids of the transcript entries to fetch. At most 500; ask for more in further requests. Send an empty array for none. |

**Response:** [`CodePipelineProcessPayloadsResponse`](../types/code-pipeline-process-payloads-response.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X POST "https://api.maitento.com/code-pipelines/processes/by-id/<id>/payloads/by-ids" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"toolUseIds":[],"contextEntryIds":[]}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
const payloads = await mt.pipelineRuns.payloads("aa11bb22-cc33-4d44-8e55-ff6677889900", { toolUseIds: ["6a7b8c9d-0e1f-4a2b-8c3d-4e5f6a7b8c9d"], contextEntryIds: [] });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.pipeline_runs.payloads("b7e6d5c4-3a2b-4c1d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", tool_use_ids=["e3f4a5b6-c7d8-4e9f-8a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b"])
```

## `pipelineRuns.resumeWithPrompt`

```http
PUT /code-pipelines/processes/by-id/{id}/resume-with-prompt
```

Resumes a run with a continuation prompt. Returns the run as it was before the update: re-read it.

**Who can call it:** Admins and members, with an API key or a portal session. [Try it in the API playground](https://docs.maitento.com/playground/?call=PUT%20%2Fcode-pipelines%2Fprocesses%2Fby-id%2F%7Bid%7D%2Fresume-with-prompt).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | yes |  |

**Request body:** [`CodePipelineProcessResumeWithPromptRequest`](../types/code-pipeline-process-resume-with-prompt-request.md)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `continuationPrompt` | `string` | yes | What to tell the agent, for example what went wrong and how to carry on. |
| `credentials` | [`CodePipelineProcessCredentialsInput`](../types/code-pipeline-process-credentials.md)`[] \| null` |  | New credentials for the run's engines, to replace the ones it started with, for example when a token has expired. Null or empty: keep the run's credentials. |
| `credentialStack` | `string \| null` |  | A credential stack (name or id) to run on from here, snapshotted now, in place of the credentials or stack the run started with. Not with `credentials`. Null: keep the run's stack. Sending `credentials` instead moves the run off its stack and onto them. |
| `repos` | [`CodePipelineProcessRepoInput`](../types/code-pipeline-process-repo.md)`[] \| null` |  | New repositories, with fresh git credentials, to replace the ones the run started with, for example when a short-lived token has expired. Null or empty: keep the run's repositories. |

**Response:** [`CodePipelineProcess`](../types/code-pipeline-process.md) (200)

<!-- tabs -->
```bash title="curl"
curl -X PUT "https://api.maitento.com/code-pipelines/processes/by-id/<id>/resume-with-prompt" \
  -H "Authorization: $MAITENTO_AUTH" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"continuationPrompt":"..."}'
```
```ts title="TypeScript"
await mt.pipelineRuns.resumeWithPrompt("aa11bb22-cc33-4d44-8e55-ff6677889900", { continuationPrompt: "Also add a regression test." });
```
```python title="Python"
mt.pipeline_runs.resume_with_prompt("b7e6d5c4-3a2b-4c1d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", continuation_prompt="Also add a test for it.")
```
